requirements.requirement: Migrate owned implementation to strict TS
requirements.evidence: All 34 production modules are checked implementation; no remaining JS or adjacent declaration bridge.
SDK sink types stay internal; public Option byte streams/Canvas unchanged. Actual VideoShim implements opt-in media view without leaking modern SDK declarations.

requirements.requirement: Preserve optional factory and art.mediabunny usage
requirements.evidence: Final isolated install repeats 17 compiler/runtime cases, whole-factory assignments against actual frozen declarations and exact Canvas result. Alias remains optional with owned teardown; prior entry tests rerun in artifact suites.

requirements.requirement: Do not falsely report all unsupported tracks ready
requirements.evidence: 16 controlled Node cases, 12 controlled browser rejection cases, eight remaining-native-decoder playback cases; active SDK messages and late-query cancellation preserved.

iterations: Original capability reproduction retained Input only in old implementation; replacement regression fixture now prepares an explicitly supported decoder while keeping the real Input alive, then runs the actual unsupported replacement.
Two original coordinator fixtures simulated successful decoder loads but omitted their working sink; added that fixture state while preserving all original ordering assertions.
limitations: canDecode=false is a controlled response, not a claim that the real browser rejects the fixture codec.
Thirty-nine Windows WebKit missing-API controls are not playback or physical Safari support evidence.
Public canPlayType remains maybe and TimeRanges/RAF remain synthetic.
Long-run synchronization, physical devices, native Document PiP and combinations remain MB-09.
Complete distribution/demo/source and license notice acceptance remain MB-10.
